empty: No drill matches these filters. Broaden the level or format.

wall-pass-ladder.title: Wall Passing Ladder
wall-pass-ladder.goal: Build a quiet platform and a feel for clean contact without needing a partner.
variants: Stand 2 m from the wall and pass 10 times in a row at net height (about 2.20 m). Count out loud.
Mark a 30x30 cm target on the wall. Hit it 5 times in a row without a lateral step.
Two targets (high / low): alternate high, low, high, low over 10 consecutive passes.
successCriteria: 10 clean passes without breaking rhythm
Feet stay grounded between passes
Contact always on straight arms, no pumping motion
coachingCues: Shoulders do the work, not the arms

triangle-drift-control.title: Triangle: Controlling the Drift
triangle-drift-control.goal: Keep the ball's lateral path under control toward the setter target despite the deliberate drift from the tosser.
variants: The tosser feeds a high ball to the passer, who sends it to zone 3 (cone target). 8 passes per passer.
The tosser adds a 1 m drift left or right. The passer must still deliver to the target.
The tosser mixes short and deep balls with lateral drift. Hold the angle to the target.
successCriteria: 6 of 8 passes on target (zone 3-4 at the net)
Platform angled to the target BEFORE contact
Visible shoulder finish, no arm swing

server-vs-passer-ladder.title: 1v1 Server / Passer Ladder
server-vs-passer-ladder.goal: Test passing under real serve pressure, with a scoring system that rewards accuracy.
variants: 8 serves. Scoring: perfect (+3), good (+1), poor (-1). No server bonus.
A serving ace costs the passer 2 points. The passer moves up a court if the total is above 12.
The server aims at a called zone (1-6). Score doubles if the pass ends up within 3 m of the net.
successCriteria: Passer scores more than 12 points over 8 serves at intermediate level
No extra steps after contact
Face the target at the finish

read-reach-receiver.title: Read and Reach
read-reach-receiver.goal: Read the server's cues from the toss and arrive set and still under the ball before contact.
variants: The server calls their zone (1-6) BEFORE serving. The passer steps in as soon as it is called.
No call. The passer reads the cues (shoulder, toss height) and starts moving on the toss.
Add a second ball sent 1.5 s after the first: pass, then immediately transition to cover.
successCriteria: Feet planted (freeze) before contact on 6 of 8 serves
Pass lands within 3 m of the net
Read called out loud ("Short!", "Deep!")

wall-set-target.title: Wall Setting to a Target
wall-set-target.goal: Build the hand triangle and repeat the same contact point on a fixed target.
variants: 30x30 cm target marked on the wall at antenna height. 10 consecutive sets, at least 7 on target.
Alternate high sets (third tempo) and low sets (second tempo) on two separate targets.
On a signal, set backward (push the hips through, finish overhead). Target 1 m behind you.
successCriteria: 7 of 10 sets on target
Hand triangle visible BEFORE contact
Feet always under the hips (no uncontrolled backward lean)

move-stop-set.title: Move, Stop, Set
move-stop-set.goal: Learn to stop and square the shoulders to the target BEFORE contact.
variants: The setter starts at a cone, runs 2 m to a tossed ball, stops and sets to the target.
The tosser varies where the ball lands (left / right / short / deep). The setter adjusts their steps.
Add a constraint: at most 2 ground contacts between the end of the run and the set (dynamic balance).
successCriteria: 6 of 8 sets land in the outside zone (4)
Nose behind the ball at contact
Full stop BEFORE contact

setter-on-the-run.title: Setting on the Move Laterally
setter-on-the-run.goal: Keep setting accurate when the pass forces a long lateral move (more than 2 m).
variants: The tosser sends 5 balls 2 m away from the setter's position. Set to zone 4 every time.
Add a back set to zone 2 (alternate front and back).
A moving hitter target: call "Hut!" or "Go!" out loud before the set.
successCriteria: 4 of 5 sets within a 1.5 m circle
Feet turned to the target BEFORE the hands
No twisting of the torso in the air

decoy-and-back-set.title: Decoy and Back Set
decoy-and-back-set.goal: Choose between front and back on a late signal, to disguise the set from the opposing block.
equipment: 1 block dummy (or a coach on the other side)
variants: The coach calls "FRONT" or "BACK" 0.5 s before contact. The setter executes.
No signal: the setter reads the position of the phantom block and sets away from it.
Add the pipe option (long back-row set) for 3 set options at once.
successCriteria: 4 of 5 correct decisions (set to the unblocked zone)
Same preparation for front and back sets
Constant set speed across variations
coachingCues: Read the blocker, not the ball

approach-shadow.title: Shadow Approach
approach-shadow.goal: Internalise the slow-to-fast rhythm of the approach, with no ball and no jump.
variants: 3-step approach (left-right-left for a right-hander), 10 reps. The coach counts "one... two-three!" to mark the slow-to-fast rhythm.
4-step approach (R-L-R-L), arms loaded at the power step, vertical jump and a clap at the 4th step.
4-step approach plus a block transition (start as middle blocker, retreat 2 steps, approach zone 4).
successCriteria: The last 2 steps are visibly faster
Arms loaded at the power step (not after)
Jump vertically, not toward the net

box-arm-swing.title: Box Hitting
box-arm-swing.goal: Isolate the wrist snap and arm finish, without the noise of the approach or jump.
variants: The hitter stands on the box, the tosser feeds a ball 50 cm off the net. Full swing, 10 reps.
Alternate full swing, cut shot (sharp angle) and line shot on the tosser's signal.
Lower the set (a flat, fast set) to compress the time available and train arm speed.
successCriteria: 7 of 10 balls land in the opposing court on the called side
Elbow above the shoulder when loaded
Visible snap (topspin on the ball)
coachingCues: High elbow, hand behind the ear
Snap over the top of the ball

approach-toss-hit.title: Approach, Toss and Hit
approach-toss-hit.goal: Sync the approach with a simple tossed ball from a coach or a steady setter.
variants: A tosser passes a high ball to zone 4. Full approach. 8 balls: 4 cross-court, 4 line.
Add a target (cone or hoop) in the aimed zone, with a bonus if the ball touches it.
Lower the set height (second tempo / go) so the hitter has to start the approach earlier.
successCriteria: 6 of 8 balls in the called zone
Take-off 30-50 cm from the net
No feet under the net on landing
coachingCues: Jump vertical, not toward the net

tempo-quick-hut-go.title: Quick / Hut / Go Tempos
tempo-quick-hut-go.goal: Tell the 3 tempos apart and start the approach at the right moment on the setter's signal.
variants: 3 hitters (OH4, MB3, OH2). The setter calls "Quick" or "Hut". Hitters who are not called run a decoy approach.
The setter stops calling: hitters start based on pass quality (a perfect pass allows a quick).
Add the pipe (back-row outside in zone 6) for 4 options at once and more pressure on the setter.
successCriteria: Correct timing: middle in the air AT the setter's contact, outsides as soon as the ball leaves the setter
No collisions between hitters
Everyone runs at full speed even without the ball (ghost middle)
coachingCues: Ghost middle at full speed, always

read-the-block.title: Reading the Block
read-the-block.goal: Choose the shot based on the position and timing of the opposing block.
variants: Two blockers line up on the line or the angle (coach's signal). The hitter attacks the open zone.
Add the tip as a third option, for when the block is perfectly set.
Live scrimmage: the hitter scores only if the ball lands OUTSIDE the block AND OUTSIDE the defense.
successCriteria: 4 of 6 attacks score
Read called out loud ("line open!", "tip!")
No attack hit into the block
coachingCues: Eyes on the block when loading, not before

pancake-floor-touch.title: Floor Pancake
pancake-floor-touch.goal: Build the reflex of sliding a flat hand under the ball for short, low balls.
variants: A partner drops a ball 1 m in front of the defender. Pancake (flat hand on the floor, the ball bounces off it). 10 reps.
The partner sends a soft, short ball 1.5 m away. Pancake on the move.
Start in a zone 6 defensive position, run and pancake a ball sent 2 m away, then roll immediately.
successCriteria: 8 of 10 clean pancakes (the ball goes up, not sideways)
Arm does not collapse at contact
Back up right away (don't stay on the floor)
coachingCues: Flat hand, back of the hand on the floor

three-ball-dig.title: Three-Ball Sequence
three-ball-dig.goal: Chain 3 different digs (short / mid-range / deep) without a break.
variants: The coach sends a short / mid / deep sequence. The defender digs each ball to the target, with a short pause between.
No pause: the coach tosses as soon as the defender has touched the previous ball.
Random order, plus a 4th "fake" ball that drops just behind the defender.
successCriteria: 3 of 3 balls dug to the target
Stay low and moving, not standing still between balls
Call out loud on every contact
coachingCues: Eyes on the ball, not on the target before contact

rapid-fire-dig.title: Rapid-Fire Digging
rapid-fire-dig.goal: Train reaction time against continuous attacks with no recovery time.
variants: The coach stands on a box and hits down balls non-stop (1 ball every 2 s). 10 balls in a row.
Faster pace (1 ball every 1.5 s) with varied zones (cross-court / line).
20 balls in a row, scored on decisions (1 point per ball played correctly, whatever the result).
successCriteria: 7 of 10 balls dug
No standing up between balls
Ball returned to the target (not just anywhere)

pursuit-and-save.title: Chase and Save
pursuit-and-save.goal: Build a "never give up" mindset and the habit of running down balls outside the defensive zone.
variants: The coach sends a ball deliberately out of range, 3 m from the defender. They run and save it (any contact counts).
Add a relay: a second player picks up the save and makes a real pass. Bonus if the third touch is attackable.
In pairs: one digs, the other covers the resulting free ball.
successCriteria: 3 of 5 saves lead to a playable third touch
Call out loud ("You!", "Mine!")
No player standing still during the sequence
coachingCues: Get a touch on it, any way you can

read-hitter-adjust.title: Read the Hitter and Adjust
read-hitter-adjust.goal: Adjust your defensive position BEFORE the hitter makes contact, by reading the approach and the arm.
variants: The defender starts neutral in zone 6. Based on the approach (cross-court / line), they step up or back 1 m BEFORE contact.
Constraint: no movement AFTER contact, pure reading.
Scoring: 2 points for a dig to the target from the right position, 1 point for a scrappy dig, 0 for a miss.
successCriteria: 4 of 6 digs from the right position (in the shadow of the block)
Feet set at contact (not moving)
Read called out loud
coachingCues: The read starts at the load, not at contact

toss-and-drop.title: Toss and Drop
toss-and-drop.goal: Make the serving toss consistent: it is 80% of the final accuracy.
variants: Mark a cross on the floor in front of the hitting shoulder. Toss the ball up and LET IT DROP on the cross, 10 times.
Same drill, aiming for a constant height (imaginary ceiling at 2.5 m for a float, 3.5 m for a jump float).
Toss while looking at the target area (not at the ball) to train blind timing.
successCriteria: 8 of 10 tosses land on the cross
Same height on every toss
The ball does not spin (a "dead" toss)
coachingCues: The hand tosses, the body stays still

six-zones-target.title: Six-Zone Targets
six-zones-target.goal: Cover all 6 zones of the opposing court with comparable execution, so you can choose tactically.
variants: One target at a time (zone 1, then 5, then 6...). 3 serves per zone. Score = number of zones with at least 2 of 3.
Random targets called by the coach BEFORE the toss. 12 serves, score = zones hit.
Add a defensive constraint (a zone between two players, or against a real libero). Score = aces plus opponent reception errors.
successCriteria: 4 of 6 zones with at least 2 of 3 successful
Same pre-serve routine on every attempt
No serve into the net

pressure-serve-game.title: Serving Under Pressure
pressure-serve-game.goal: Serve under scoring pressure to simulate the end of a set.
variants: 5 serves in a row. In and beyond 3 m = +1. Missed (net / out) = -1. Minimum score: +3.
Add a final "match point" serve: if missed, back to 0 and start again.
Three servers compete. First to 10 points wins.
successCriteria: Score of +3 or better over 5 serves
Same pre-serve routine, critical point or not
No rushing after a miss
coachingCues: Same routine, critical point or not

tactical-zone-serve.title: Serving to the Opponent's Weak Spot
tactical-zone-serve.goal: Pick the serving zone based on the weakness you have spotted in the opponent.
variants: Before each serve, the server calls "ace in 1" (zone) and names the weak passer. Then executes.
Scoring: +3 ace, +1 broken pass, 0 perfect pass, -1 error.
Scout first: the opponent plays a full set, the serving team identifies weak zones, then exploits them.
successCriteria: At least 2 aces in 8 serves
Zone choice justified out loud
No "automatic" serve (always zone 1)

shadow-block-mirror.title: Mirror Blocking
shadow-block-mirror.goal: Sync lateral movement and the jump without a ball, mirroring a partner.
variants: Two players face each other across the net. One moves left / right, the other mirrors. Jump on the "up!" signal.
Add a jump with a press over the net (hands reach into the opponent's side). 10 lateral reps.
3 blockers in a line (zones 2-3-4). The coach calls an attack zone, all 3 move and form a double block in that zone.
successCriteria: Smooth lateral steps (no uncontrolled crossing)
Hands above the net at the peak
Stable landing (no loss of balance)

footwork-net-touch.title: Lateral Footwork and Net Press
footwork-net-touch.goal: Choose the right step (shuffle vs crossover) for the distance, and finish with hands high at the net.
variants: Shuffle 1 m (zone 3 to zone 4), jump, hands high. 8 reps.
Crossover 3 m (zone 4 to zone 2), jump, hands high. Work on the timing of the last step (outside foot).
Alternate shuffle and crossover on the coach's signal (short = shuffle / long = crossover) in under 0.5 s.
successCriteria: Last step square to the net (no crooked foot)
Hands 30 cm above the tape at the peak
No jumping backward

read-setter-block.title: Reading the Setter (Commit vs Read)
read-setter-block.goal: Decide between commit (an early jump on a quick) and read (jump on the chosen hitter).
variants: The setter signals their set (front / back) BEFORE the toss. The middle commits, the outsides read.
No signal: the middle must read the setter's shoulder angle and decide in under 0.3 s.
Add the pipe (back-row outside) for 4 options. The middle becomes a pure read blocker.
successCriteria: 4 of 6 correct decisions (block on the real hitter)
Middle never caught between two hitters
Call out loud "FRONT!" or "BACK!"
coachingCues: Read the setter, not the ball

seal-the-seam-duo.title: Sealing the Seam as a Pair
seal-the-seam-duo.goal: Two blockers (middle and outside) close either the line or the angle, leaving no seam between them.
variants: "Line" block: the middle closes the line, the outside takes the angle. 6 reps.
"Angle" block: the middle takes the angle, the outside closes the line. 6 reps.
Live decision: the coach calls "LINE" or "ANGLE" 0.5 s before the set. Both adjust.
successCriteria: 5 of 6 blocks with sealed hands (no visible seam between the two blockers)
Both blockers arrive at the same time
No lateral drift after the jump
coachingCues: Shoulder to shoulder at the peak

pepper-progressive.title: Progressive Pepper
pepper-progressive.goal: Work all 3 contacts in a loop with a partner, building up the intensity.
variants: Classic pepper with no jumping. Dig, set, soft-hand "spike". Goal: 10 cycles in a row.
"Down ball pepper": the hitter hits standing, down-ball style. Dig, set, down ball.
Pepper with a jump and targets: the hitter must hit a zone called by the setter (left / right).
successCriteria: 10 cycles in a row without a break
Talk ("Mine!", "Yours!")
Every contact sets up the next one (no "selfish" ball)

side-out-wash-3.title: Side-Out Wash x3
side-out-wash-3.goal: Win a point only after 3 consecutive side-outs, with the focus on error-free execution.
variants: 3 serves in a row. 3 successful side-outs = +1 point. A miss at any point means starting over.
After each side-out, the defending team plays out the rally (transition). Only side-outs count.
Reverse scoring: the serving team scores if it stops the third side-out. First to 5 wins.
successCriteria: At least 1 run of 3 side-outs per team over 10 serves
Hitter coverage on every attack
Constant communication (pass-set-hit called out)

triangle-transition.title: Transition Triangle
triangle-transition.goal: Chain pass, set and attack plus coverage with no downtime.
variants: The coach hits a down ball, the team defends (3 contacts). After the attack, cover in a triangle (setter plus 2 back-row players).
The coach varies cross-court / line / tip: the team works out who digs and who covers.
Chain 2 transitions in a row: defense, attack and cover, new defense, new attack.
successCriteria: Coverage triangle on every attack (3 players 2 m from the hitter)
No one standing still during the rally
Constant communication

queen-of-the-court.title: Queen of the Court
queen-of-the-court.goal: A competitive game mode: winning a rally moves you up to the "royal court", losing sends you back.
variants: 3 teams. The "queen" team receives the serve. If it scores, it stays. If it loses, it leaves and the next team moves up.
Tactical constraint: the win must come from a third-tempo attack (otherwise 0 points even if the rally is won).
Bonus: 2 points if the win comes off a clean side-out (pass-set-hit) with no transition.
successCriteria: Smooth rotation between the 3 teams
No waiting between rotations
Intensity held for 20+ minutes
